//: x402 micropayments for Payment Guard. To turn ON: set enabled=true and paste your wallet into payTo. payTo MUST be an EVM address (0x + 40 hex) that receives USDC on the BASE network. A Bitcoin address (starts with 1, 3, or bc1) will NOT work and the gate will refuse to activate. Get a Base 0x address in Coinbase: Receive -> USDC -> choose the Base network -> copy the 0x... address (or use a Coinbase Smart Wallet).
